repos.name: self_guard
repos.description: Self‑Guard is a production-grade runtime integrity library that protects applications against debugging, memory tampering, timing attacks, and execution flow anomalies. It combines a C API, secure C++ core, and assembly checks to provide fail-secure, thread-safe, and high-performance protection for security-critical software.

repos.name: nullbyte-academy

It bridges the gap between engineers and programmers, providing hands-on labs, visual guides, and practical exercises to master secure software design and vulnerability analysis.

repos.name: RevengeDNS
repos.description: RevengeDNS is a defensive DNS security system built with TypeScript and Node.js. It inspects DNS traffic in real time, detects malicious domains (malware, phishing, ads), and redirects threats to a secure local sinkhole.

repos.name: GitForce
repos.description: GitForce is a Python tool for automating GitHub tasks like auto-following users, starring repositories, and following stargazers. It uses GitHub Personal Access Tokens for secure authentication, supports multi-threading, and includes smart rate-limiting to optimize performance across platforms.

repos.description: CodeJudge_Hell is a courtroom-style static analysis tool for Python files. It puts every script on trial — with a Prosecutor, Defense Attorney, and Judge — then calculates the probability that the file is malicious and delivers a final verdict (CLEAN, YELLOW, or CRIMSON) with a confidence score.
